flash_693440.description:
Israel's Ambassador to the US Yechiel Leiter reflects on Rosh Hashanah, September 11 and Charlie Kirk, calling for peace, resilience, freedom and life.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Rosh Hashanah in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_693439.description:
A newly declassified CIA memo from 1998 warned President Bill Clinton that Al-Qaeda leader could target the US with a hijacked, explosive-packed commercial airplane.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Rosh Hashanah in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_221357.description:
Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat and Rosh Hashanah in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Sunday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Rosh Hashanah at 19:24 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom and Shana Tova!

flash_693448.description: Two suspects allegedly hurled anti-Semitic slurs before attacking a Jewish woman with a broken glass bottle in central Berlin.

flash_693447.description: NYT report reveals deep divisions in Iran over war and US talks, as officials question Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei’s role and authority.

flash_693446.description:
The Joint List and the United Arab List (Ra’am) signed a surplus-vote agreement ahead of the elections in a bid to prevent votes from going to waste.

Under the agreement, the parties pledged to conduct a “fair and clean election campaign" and refrain from smears, defamation and incitement. The agreement will be submitted to the Central Elections Committee after the candidate lists are approved.

flash_693445.description: SFC Itai Parson, 23, disappeared while freediving off Haifa as his family waited nearby; his body was located following an extensive three-day search.

flash_693444.description: Trump envoy Jared Kushner says US administration capitalized on Israel's growing diplomatic isolation following failed Doha strike to push Israeli government toward Gaza agreement.

flash_693443.description: Ship struck in Strait of Hormuz

flash_693442.description:
Earlier today (Sunday), the IDF struck in the Gaza City area and eliminated the terrorists Hassan Ali Abu Nada and Abd al-Rahim Ahmad Khalil Khawa, operatives in the engineering unit of Hamas’ military wing.

Recently, the terrorists were involved in the production and development of weapons, advanced terror attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians, and attempted to reconstitute the terrorist organization’s capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorists were eliminated in order to remove the threat they posed.

flash_693460.description: Twenty-five years later, the most unbearable images of September 11 still demand that we remember not only the victims, but the ideology that murdered them. Opinion.

flash_693459.description: Iranian reports of explosion in the port city of Sirik near the Strait of Hormuz

flash_693457.description: Ukrainian police investigate after 45-year-old British Jewish man is found dead in a forest near Rabbi Nachman’s tomb during Rosh Hashanah.

flash_693455.description: Four suspects, including an Israeli citizen, were arrested after police uncovered cocaine, cash and more than 126 kilograms of ketamine in searches near Limassol.

flash_693453.description: Yehuda Widawski survived the Lodz Ghetto and Auschwitz before building a new life in Israel and dedicating decades to preserving Jewish heritage in Poland.

flash_693451.description: Leeds Minster removes panels containing 12 names linked to Palestinian Islamic Jihad after Jewish group raises concerns over its Gaza war memorial.

flash_693449.description: Ambassador Yechiel Leiter rejects claims that Jews are occupiers in Judea and Samaria, stressing the region’s historic, religious and strategic importance.

flash_693464.description: IDF responds to claims of war crimes and genocide as presented on Israeli film. "The IDF categorically rejects these allegations"

flash_693463.description: Asked on 60 Minutes about munitions shortages, US Central Command Chief Brad Cooper answered: ""I am not concerned at all. We're well armed and ready for any contingency."

flash_693462.description: G-d is not here to catch us but to help us reach our tikkun, rectification. Each failure is merely a test that we were unable to overcome, but G-d is not done. Another similar test will come our way to see if we can overcome it.

flash_693461.description: Culture Minister Miki Zohar accuses the creators of Naza of betraying Israel after the documentary won an award at the Venice Film Festival.

flash_693458.description: Omani Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi announced on Sunday that a meeting between Iran and the Gulf States to discuss the Strait of Hormuz, which was scheduled for tomorrow, has been postponed "in the interests of consensus."

flash_693456.description: Likud says it will seek to disqualify the Arab parties, citing their alleged support for terrorism and ties to hostile organizations.

flash_693454.description: Defense Minister Katz says IDF will remain in southern Lebanon’s security zone until Hezbollah is disarmed, warning anyone approaching Ali al-Taher Ridge.

flash_693452.description: Former New York Governor George Pataki reflects on 9/11, the unity he witnessed in New York, and why he fears its lessons are being forgotten.

flash_693450.description: The IDF withdrew from the Ali al-Taher Ridge and redeployed along the Yellow Line. For now, troops remain in the area of Beaufort Ridge.

flash_693465.description: Israel is holding discussions ahead of a new flotilla expected to depart Italy in late October, while the IDF has already begun initial preparations to stop it.
